notes.title: Steam achievements are now available!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Midnight Witch has been released for almost two months now, and quite a few people have been asking for achievements - I am very happy to announce that 11 achievements are now available for Midnight Witch!
Some of them are quite straight-forward, but some will force you to dig a bit deeper into the game - good luck!

Thank you so much for all who left a review or purchased the fan pack, it means so much!

All the best,

Bren

notes.title: Midnight Witch is AVAILABLE NOW
notes.notes:
Hey there,

Midnight Witch is finally out! You can download it for free here on Steam - we really hope you will enjoy it!

Please let us know about your feedback in the comment or review section, it means a lot to us!
